answer_1.quote: instruction tuning is the process of fine-tuning LLMs on an instruction-response dataset to enable LLMs to generate expected responses based on given instructions.
answer_1.outputs: Generated responses to instructions and expanded instructions.

answer_2.quote: We employed the FOG to measure the complexity of instruction data and used the MTLD, a length-robust metric, to assess the lexical diversity of instructions.

answer_3.quote: Using GPT-4 as the evaluator, we score the multi-turn dialogue content generated by LLMs on a scale from 1 to 10.

answer_4.quote: We recruited three highly educated annotators to assess the outputs of our Global Eye (GPT-4 base, LLaMA2-13B) model against other comparison models.
answer_4.guideline: judging wins, losses, or ties between pairs of outputs
